hooks.SessionStart: Prime guidance, plus a one-time instruction to ask the user their explanation level while `.shahinkit-data/explain-mode` is unset
hooks.UserPromptSubmit: Caveman and plain-English restatement only; reads event cwd for opt-out matching, never the prompt text

caveman.delivery: rendered-static-context, explicit commands, and per-turn restatement
caveman.hook_rationale: Static instruction context decays over a long session. The restatement is advisory additionalContext only.

explain_mode.effect: `plain` adds a per-turn instruction to explain commands, files, and errors in plain English without dropping substance or warnings. Missing or unrecognised means unset, so SessionStart asks the user once.
explain_mode.written_by: the agent after the user answers, or the user by hand

path_opt_out.format: one absolute path prefix per line, `#` comments ignored
path_opt_out.effect: Suppresses all ShahinKit lifecycle context when the event cwd is at or under a listed path.
